categories.title: Ancient Magic Hotspot
categories.info: Interact with the Ancient Magic Hotspot to spawn bubbles; gather them all to complete the challenge and increase your Ancient Magic meter capacity.

categories.title: Bandit Camp
categories.info: Bandit Camps house some loot, guarded by a number of Dark Wizards.

categories.title: Beast Den
categories.info: After completing The Elf, the Nab-Sack and the Loom, you can visit Beasts Den to rescue Magical Beasts. Tend to them in the Room of Requirements to obtain their corresponding materials.

categories.title: Creature Lair
categories.info: Creature Lairs contain a large amount of their respective creature.

categories.title: Floo Flame
categories.info: Floo Flames are Fast Travel points, accessible from anywhere on the map.

categories.title: Hamlet
categories.info: Hamlet are little settlement spread through the Highlands. They often contain shops, NPCs and quests.

categories.title: Hedge Maze
categories.info: Hedge Mazes appear randomly, and always contain a lore note and a Legendary Chest at the end.

categories.title: Merlin Trial
categories.info: Merlin Trial are magical puzzles, that often require a specific spell to solve. They can be started by spending a Marrowsweet Leaf on top of the swirl pattern.

categories.title: Treasure Vault
categories.info: Treasure Vaults are small, locked dungeons that contain gear or loot.

categories.title: Vendor
categories.info: Vendors sell various items, tools and gear for the player to purchase. They also buy gear off the player.

categories.title: Balloon
categories.info: Balloons appear high in the air; fly through all of them on a broom or mount to complete.

categories.title: Conjuration
categories.info: Conjurations are decorations for the Room of Requirements. They are found in hexagonal Collection Chests.

categories.title: Demiguise Statue
categories.info: After completing The Caretaker's Lunar Lament, you can collect Demiguise Moons by approaching the statues at night. Trade theses statues in to the Caretaker to upgrade the Alohomora Spell.

categories.title: Field Guide Page
categories.info: Field Guide Pages are hidden everywhere. Collecting one grants 80 XP and adds it to the collection log.

categories.title: Landing Platform
categories.info: Land on Landing Platforms from a broom or a mount to activate them.

categories.title: Trait
categories.info: Trait are upgrades that can be placed on Extraordinary and Legendary gear in the Room of Requirements. They are found in rectangular Collection Chests, and are randomized for each player.

categories.title: Wand Handle
categories.info: Wand Handles are decorations for your character's wand. They are found in cylindrical Collection Chests.

categories.title: Chest
categories.info: Chests can contain a variety of items, such as galleons, Wiggenweld potions or gear. Large and Locked chests always contain gear. Contents are randomized from player to player.

categories.title: Eye Chest
categories.info: Eye Chests can be opened after learning the Disillusionment Charm; approach the chest without being seen to open it.

categories.title: Legendary Chest
categories.info: Legendary Chests contain a legendary piece of gear, scaled to your level.

categories.title: Infamous Foe
categories.info: Infamous Foes are formidable, over-leveled enemies.

categories.title: Butterflies
categories.info: Follow the Butterflies to a Treasure Chest!

categories.title: Lock
categories.info: Locks are unlocked with the Alohomora spell, acquired after The Caretaker's Lunar Lament. Level II and III locks require completion of The Man Behind the Moons.
